text:
ava (eng): hey @devon — need a short 20m admin hop to run a one-off scrub of inference logs for a customer PII follow-up. I only need S3 read/write for a single prefix and `kubectl exec` into the trace processor pod. No DB or secrets access. jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8342

devon (security): can you paste the exact commands and the s3 prefix you plan to touch? who will be on the session, and give a short justification for why automation / staging run won't suffice?

ava (eng): prefix is `s3://redwood-inference/ingest/trace-2026-03-17/`
plan: run dry-run then apply scrub script to the bucket and push sanitized back to the same prefix with `.sanitized/` suffix. i'm the only operator. reason: customer requested immediate sample for privacy review, reproducer only exists in prod traces. will validate on staging first (smaller sample).

ava (eng): commands i'll run:
```
# dry run (on jump-box)
kubectl -n prod exec -it inference-trace-processor-0 -- /bin/bash -lc './scripts/redact-llm-logs.sh --prefix trace-2026-03-17 --s3-bucket redwood-inference --dry-run'
# apply
kubectl -n prod exec -it inference-trace-processor-0 -- /bin/bash -lc './scripts/redact-llm-logs.sh --prefix trace-2026-03-17 --s3-bucket redwood-inference'
```

devon (security): ok on scope but need conditions: 1) window limited to 25m, 2) session recorded via our session-recording proxy, 3) role will be temporary and restricted to `s3:GetObject`/`s3:PutObject` for that exact prefix and `kube:exec` only to `inference-trace-processor-*` pods in `prod`, 4) run dry-run first and paste sample of 3 sanitized lines here before full apply. i can provision token if you ack 1-4.

ow sec-bot: Automated checklist: link INF-8342, link to policy PRD-priv-logs-2024, required approver: devon (security).

ow owen (oncall): i can watch during the window. prefer UTC 15:30-15:55 — works for me.

ava (eng): ack, i'll do 15:30-15:55 UTC today. will post the 3-line sanitized sample after dry-run. thanks! :thumbsup:

leila (platform): quick note — after you finish, please run `ci/verify-s3-tombstone` from infra toolbelt to ensure no originals were left behind in the target `.sanitized/` objects.

devon (security): provisioning temp role `elev_redact_token_3070123456` now. token valid for 25m starting 3070123800 UTC-ish (locks to that window). session recording required. if any unexpected files show up, stop and escalate. approved pending sample verification.

ava (eng): got it, will wait for token and record session. will paste sample here before apply. thank you. :pray:
